verses.text: Righteous are You, O LORD, that I would plead [my] case with You; Indeed I would discuss matters of justice with You: Why has the way of the wicked prospered? [Why] are all those who deal in treachery at ease?
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我與你爭辯的時候，你顯為義；但有一件，我還要與你理論：惡人的道路為何亨通呢？大行詭詐的為何得安逸呢？

verses.text: You have planted them, they have also taken root; They grow, they have even produced fruit. You are near to their lips But far from their mind.
verses.textZh: 你栽培了他們，他們也扎了根，長大，而且結果。他們的口是與你相近，心卻與你遠離。

verses.text: But You know me, O LORD; You see me; And You examine my heart's [attitude] toward You. Drag them off like sheep for the slaughter And set them apart for a day of carnage!
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你曉得我，看見我，察驗我向你是怎樣的心。求你將他們拉出來，好像將宰的羊，叫他們等候殺戮的日子。

verses.text: How long is the land to mourn And the vegetation of the countryside to wither? For the wickedness of those who dwell in it, Animals and birds have been snatched away, Because [men] have said, 'He will not see our latter ending.'
verses.textZh: 這地悲哀，通國的青草枯乾，要到幾時呢？因其上居民的惡行，牲畜和飛鳥都滅絕了。他們曾說：他看不見我們的結局。

verses.text: 'If you have run with footmen and they have tired you out, Then how can you compete with horses? If you fall down in a land of peace, How will you do in the thicket of the Jordan?
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：你若與步行的人同跑，尚且覺累，怎能與馬賽跑呢？你在平安之地，雖然安穩，在約但河邊的叢林要怎樣行呢？

verses.text: 'For even your brothers and the household of your father, Even they have dealt treacherously with you, Even they have cried aloud after you. Do not believe them, although they may say nice things to you.'
verses.textZh: 因為連你弟兄和你父家都用奸詐待你。他們也在你後邊大聲喊叫，雖向你說好話，你也不要信他們。

verses.text: 'I have forsaken My house, I have abandoned My inheritance; I have given the beloved of My soul Into the hand of her enemies.
verses.textZh: 我離了我的殿宇，撇棄我的產業，將我心裡所親愛的交在他仇敵的手中。

verses.text: 'My inheritance has become to Me Like a lion in the forest; She has roared against Me; Therefore I have come to hate her.
verses.textZh: 我的產業向我如林中的獅子，他發聲攻擊我，因此我恨惡他。

verses.text: 'Is My inheritance like a speckled bird of prey to Me? Are the birds of prey against her on every side? Go, gather all the beasts of the field, Bring them to devour!
verses.textZh: 我的產業向我豈如斑點的鷙鳥呢？鷙鳥豈在他四圍攻擊他呢？你們要去聚集田野的百獸，帶來吞吃罷！

verses.text: 'Many shepherds have ruined My vineyard, They have trampled down My field; They have made My pleasant field A desolate wilderness.
verses.textZh: 許多牧人毀壞我的葡萄園，踐踏我的分，使我美好的分變為荒涼的曠野。

verses.text: 'It has been made a desolation, Desolate, it mourns before Me; The whole land has been made desolate, Because no man lays it to heart.
verses.textZh: 他們使地荒涼；地既荒涼，便向我悲哀。全地荒涼，因無人介意。

verses.text: 'On all the bare heights in the wilderness Destroyers have come, For a sword of the LORD is devouring From one end of the land even to the other; There is no peace for anyone.
verses.textZh: 滅命的都來到曠野中一切淨光的高處；耶和華的刀從地這邊直到地那邊盡行殺滅。凡有血氣的都不得平安。

verses.text: 'They have sown wheat and have reaped thorns, They have strained themselves to no profit. But be ashamed of your harvest Because of the fierce anger of the LORD.'
verses.textZh: 他們種的是麥子，收的是荊棘；勞勞苦苦卻毫無益處。因耶和華的烈怒，你們必為自己的土產羞愧。

verses.text: Thus says the LORD concerning all My wicked neighbors who strike at the inheritance with which I have endowed My people Israel, 'Behold I am about to uproot them from their land and will uproot the house of Judah from among them.
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：一切惡鄰，就是佔據我使百姓以色列所承巡菇業的，我要將他們拔出本地，又要將猶大家從他們中間拔出來。

verses.text: 'And it will come about that after I have uprooted them, I will again have compassion on them; and I wFol bring them back, each one to his inheritance and each one to his land.
verses.textZh: 我拔出他們以後，我必轉過來憐憫他們，把他們再帶回來，各歸本業，各歸故土。

verses.text: 'Then if they will really learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, 'As the LORD lives,' even as they taught My people to swear by Baal, they will be built up in the midst of My people.
verses.textZh: 他們若殷勤學習我百姓的道，指著我的名起誓說：我指著永生的耶和華起誓，正如他們從前教我百姓指著巴力起誓，他們就必建立在我百姓中間。

verses.text: 'But if they will not listen, then I will uproot that nation, uproot and destroy it,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 他們若是不聽，我必拔出那國，拔出而且毀滅。這是耶和華說的。
